statements.impact_statement: The Node runtime is constrained to ^22.23.4 || ^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1 by the shared runtime policy, checked again by the inventory producer. Node documents the Brotli decoder fix in these security releases despite process.versions.brotli retaining 1.2.0. The measured Node24.22.2 executable is recorded by SHA256. This disposition concerns Node-bundled Brotli, not standalone unpatched Brotli. https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/october-2026-security-releases#nodejs-brotli-decoder-out-of-bounds-write-permits-remote-code-execution-cve-2026-111497---high

NVD matches without an appropriate modern V8 upper bound. The CVE concerns Node before0.12.6 / io.js before1.8.3/2.3.3; the measured V8 is bundled in supported Node24.22.2. https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2015-5380 and https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2015-security-releases . Exact V8 product version only; reassess other findings.

All affected copies are development-only Jest, TypeScript-ESLint and watcher dependencies. Patterns come from checked-in test/lint configuration and developer-selected paths; manuscript/MCP inputs cannot provide extglob expressions. npm lock dev-only status is enforced by the inventory producer. Evidence: npm ls picomatch --all and package-lock.json. Reassess any production use or untrusted pattern input.

The Marvin advisory concerns RustCrypto RSA private-key operations observable through timing. This binding exports asset inspection and signing through ClaimSigner (native/c2pa-binding/src/lib.rs), whose AsyncSigner implementation calls a JavaScript callback with bounded message bytes and receives only signature bytes. It never receives a private key. src/services/content-credentials/sdk-worker.ts decrypts encrypted PKCS8 into a Node KeyObject and createRawCredentialSigner performs RSA-PSS using node:crypto/OpenSSL with explicit PSS padding and digest-sized salt. Public verification remains in the SDK; no Rust RSA private-key decryption/signing operation is exposed. tests/unit/services/content-credentials-sdk.test.ts independently verifies real PSS callback signatures. Exact binding architecture and rsa 0.9.10 only; reassess if private keys or native signing are introduced. The dependency itself remains unpatched: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2023-0071.html .

The CNA describes predictable V8 string hash collisions in 2011-era engines. The measured Node 24.22.2 runtime uses V8 13.6.233.17-node.63. Its pinned source initializes the default hash seed from isolate.random_number_generator()->NextInt64() and supplies that seed to string hashing, rather than the historical predictable hash implementation: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/v24.22.2/deps/v8/src/numbers/hash-seed.cc and https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/v24.22.2/deps/v8/src/strings/string-hasher-inl.h . The raw CNA record and source snapshots are retained in the security follow-up evidence. Exact V8 product version in the supported default Node runtime only; not a general denial-of-service immunity claim.

The CNA record identifies V8 as used in Chrome before 15.0.874.102; the Chrome 15.0.874.102 release explicitly includes the fix. The measured product is modern V8 13.6.233.17-node.63 in Node 24.22.2, not that 2011 engine. This match results from the broad historical V8 CPE record. References: https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2011/10/chrome-stable-release.html and https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2011-3886 . Exact V8 product version only; reassess other versions and advisories.

The flaw is in the sqlite3 command-line shell's .recover output (src/shell.c.in, ext/recover/sqlite3recover.c), reported through 3.54.1 with no fixed release. Neither measured copy contains that code: Node 24.22.2 does not build or ship the shell, and @photostructure/sqlite 3.3.1 compiles only the library amalgamation src/upstream/sqlite3.c, which has no shell or sqlite3_recover symbols. scrivener-mcp never invokes a sqlite3 executable. https://abraxaslabs.tech/research/sqlite-cli-recover . Exact sqlite 3.53.4 and 3.54.1 products only; reassess if a SQLite release fixes the shell or the driver's build sources change.

The only remaining SQLite 3.53.4 copy is the one compiled into Node 24.22.2 (process.versions.sqlite), reachable solely through node:sqlite, which neither src/ nor any production dependency imports. The server's SQLite driver is @photostructure/sqlite, which bundles its own SQLite 3.54.1 that already contains this fix; it does not load Node's copy. The overflow is in the session extension's sqlite3changeset_apply(), reached in Node only through DatabaseSync.applyChangeset(). https://github.com/sqlite/sqlite/commit/64459c87cc702d600704fb77ee40ca1782398a52 . Remove this statement once every supported Node release bundles SQLite 3.54.0 or newer. Exact sqlite 3.53.4 product only; reassess any node:sqlite or dependency change.

The server's SQLite driver is @photostructure/sqlite, which bundles its own SQLite 3.54.1 that already contains this fix; it does not load Node's copy. fts5DoSecureDelete() additionally requires deletes from an FTS5 table with secure-delete enabled. https://github.com/sqlite/sqlite/commit/d9de6eedbe918c074c7556400fa21df5960704d9 . Remove this statement once every supported Node release bundles SQLite 3.54.0 or newer. Exact sqlite 3.53.4 product only; reassess any node:sqlite or dependency change.

The server's SQLite driver is @photostructure/sqlite, which bundles its own SQLite 3.54.1 that already contains this fix; it does not load Node's copy. fts5MergeRowidLists() additionally requires a prefix MATCH over a detail=none FTS5 table. https://github.com/sqlite/sqlite/commit/e1c9934f9f11a499029abb020ea715a08970da80 . Remove this statement once every supported Node release bundles SQLite 3.54.0 or newer. Exact sqlite 3.53.4 product only; reassess any node:sqlite or dependency change.

AES-GCM-SIV IV-length out-of-bounds read. AES-GCM-SIV is reachable from Node only through crypto.createCipheriv/createDecipheriv with an "aes-*-gcm-siv" cipher name. The only cipher scrivener-mcp creates is aes-256-cbc (src/services/content-credentials/key-policy.ts), and no installed package references gcm-siv; the c2pa binding is WebAssembly and does not link Node OpenSSL. Applies to the OpenSSL 3.5.9 bundled in the supported Node runtime until a Node release ships OpenSSL >= 3.5.10; remove this statement then. https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20261110.txt

AES-GCM-SIV zero-length AAD reset. AES-GCM-SIV is reachable from Node only through crypto.createCipheriv/createDecipheriv with an "aes-*-gcm-siv" cipher name. The only cipher scrivener-mcp creates is aes-256-cbc (src/services/content-credentials/key-policy.ts), and no installed package references gcm-siv; the c2pa binding is WebAssembly and does not link Node OpenSSL. Applies to the OpenSSL 3.5.9 bundled in the supported Node runtime until a Node release ships OpenSSL >= 3.5.10; remove this statement then. https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20261110.txt

Use-after-free in the OpenSSL QUIC client. Node does not use the OpenSSL QUIC stack: its experimental node:quic is built on ngtcp2 (nodejs/node src/quic) and node src references no OSSL_QUIC method. scrivener-mcp never imports node:quic or passes --experimental-quic. Applies to the OpenSSL 3.5.9 bundled in the supported Node runtime until a Node release ships OpenSSL >= 3.5.10; remove this statement then. https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20261110.txt

CMS_encrypt()/CMS_encrypt_ex() infinite loop. Node exposes no CMS API (nodejs/node src contains no CMS_ calls), and the advisory states the OpenSSL TLS and QUIC implementations do not use this path. Applies to the OpenSSL 3.5.9 bundled in the supported Node runtime until a Node release ships OpenSSL >= 3.5.10; remove this statement then. https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20261110.txt

PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio_ex() use-after-free when the caller passes an existing stack and the read fails. Node src contains no PEM_X509_INFO_* call (it loads certificates with PEM_read_bio_X509), and the advisory states OpenSSL's own callers always pass NULL. Checked against nodejs/node src and deps/ncrypto at v22.23.4, v24.22.3 and v26.13.1. Applies to the OpenSSL 3.5.9 bundled in the supported Node runtime until a Node release ships OpenSSL >= 3.5.10; remove this statement then. https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20261117.txt

Unbounded RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID queueing in the OpenSSL QUIC stack. Node does not use the OpenSSL QUIC stack: its experimental node:quic is built on ngtcp2 (src/quic) and node src references no OSSL_QUIC method. scrivener-mcp never imports node:quic or passes --experimental-quic. Checked against nodejs/node src and deps/ncrypto at v22.23.4, v24.22.3 and v26.13.1. Applies to the OpenSSL 3.5.9 bundled in the supported Node runtime until a Node release ships OpenSSL >= 3.5.10; remove this statement then. https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/33544

Quadratic CPU when verifying CMS/PKCS#7 SignedData with CRL checking. Node exposes no CMS or PKCS#7 verification API (no CMS_ or PKCS7_ calls in node src); content credentials are verified by the c2pa WebAssembly binding, which does not link Node OpenSSL. Checked against nodejs/node src and deps/ncrypto at v22.23.4, v24.22.3 and v26.13.1. Applies to the OpenSSL 3.5.9 bundled in the supported Node runtime until a Node release ships OpenSSL >= 3.5.10; remove this statement then. https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/33546

Out-of-bounds read only when a server sets SSL_CERT_FLAG_SUITEB_* through SSL_CTX_set_cert_flags() with TLS 1.3 enabled. Node src never calls SSL_CTX_set_cert_flags or SSL_set_cert_flags, and the advisory states default configurations do not reach this code. Checked against nodejs/node src and deps/ncrypto at v22.23.4, v24.22.3 and v26.13.1. Applies to the OpenSSL 3.5.9 bundled in the supported Node runtime until a Node release ships OpenSSL >= 3.5.10; remove this statement then. https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20261117.txt

NULL dereference in a DANE-enabled TLS client. Node src makes no SSL_dane_* call, so DANE is never enabled on Node TLS connections. Checked against nodejs/node src and deps/ncrypto at v22.23.4, v24.22.3 and v26.13.1. Applies to the OpenSSL 3.5.9 bundled in the supported Node runtime until a Node release ships OpenSSL >= 3.5.10; remove this statement then. https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/33634

DTLS out-of-sequence fragment buffering memory growth; the advisory states TLS and QUIC are unaffected. Node 22 and 24 contain no DTLS code. Node 26 adds node:dtls (src/dtls) only behind --experimental-dtls; scrivener-mcp and its dependencies never import node:dtls or pass that flag. Checked against nodejs/node src and deps/ncrypto at v22.23.4, v24.22.3 and v26.13.1. Applies to the OpenSSL 3.5.9 bundled in the supported Node runtime until a Node release ships OpenSSL >= 3.5.10; remove this statement then. https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/33620
